confidence_policy.comment: Entities below min_confidence are blocked. Relationships require higher confidence.
confidence_policy.null_handling: allow_null_confidence=true means entities without confidence scores are allowed (backward compatibility)
confidence_policy.strict_mode: strict_mode=true requires all entities to have confidence scores

thresholds_rationale.entity_0.70: Filters out ~20% lowest confidence extractions while preserving most valid entities
thresholds_rationale.relationship_0.80: Relationships need higher confidence as they connect entities and can propagate errors
